Orders ship from our Canadian distribution network, using Purolator, Canada Post, UPS, and FedEx depending on your location — everything is shipped within Canada only. You can see full details on the [Shipping policy](https://replogleglobes.ca/policies/shipping-policy) page.

Are you looking at the Pioneer for yourself, or is it a gift?
Im looking for ideas for my Christmas list. It will be for me but im wanting something visually pleasing, yet accurate for educational purposes. Around 150 or less canadian

The Replogle Carlyle Illuminated Desk Globe - Antique Ocean, 12" is a great fit — it's cartographically accurate with crisp political detail, and the illumination gives it a warm glow that makes it a real conversation piece on a desk or shelf, all at $135 CAD, comfortably under your budiget. If you'd rather have the bright, classic schoolhouse look instead of the warm antique tones, the Replogle Odessa 12" Illuminated Desk Globe in Blue Ocean at $125 CAD is just as sharp for reading detail.

You'll find the Carlyle under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your list.

What drew you to wanting something you could use for learning, not just looking at?
I don't know if id like it to illuminate, im not wanting cords

No cords at all then — the Replogle Sierra 12" Antique Ocean Desk Globe is a nice pick: raised relief terrain you can feel under your fingers for the educational side, a metal base and warm antique-ocean map for the look, no plug needed, all at $135 CAD. If you'd prefer the brighter, classic blue-ocean map instead of the antique sepia tones, the Replogle Pioneer 12" Desktop Blue Ocean Globe with raised relief at $134 CAD gives you that same tactile accuracy.

You'll find the Sierra under that exact name in search, ready to add to your list.
Can you show me both of these last 2 globes
Searched the catalog · Replogle Sierra 12 Antique Ocean Desk Globe
Searched the catalog · Pioneer 12-inch Desktop Blue Ocean Globe Raised Relief Gyro-

Here's a closer look at each:

**Replogle Sierra 12" Antique Ocean Desk Globe** – warm parchment-toned ocean, raised relief mountains, over 4,000 labeled locations, with a two-toned antique brass and black metal base. ($135 CAD) Picture a classic library-style globe with that aged-map look.

**Replogle Pioneer 12" Desktop Blue Ocean Globe** – crisp, bright blue-ocean political map, also raised relief, mounted in a bronze-toned Gyro-matic swivel that tilts on two axes so you can spin it fully to see the poles. ($134 CAD)

You can see the actual photos by searching either name on the site — the Sierra page shows the warm antique tones and brass base, the Pioneer page shows the vivid blue ocean and gold swivel mount. Which look are you drawn to, the vintage parchment or the bright classic blue?

Good choice — the Replogle Sierra 12" Antique Ocean Desk Globe it is, with its warm parchment seas, raised-relief mountains, and brass-toned base, no cords needed. You'll find it under that exact name in search, ready to add to your Christmas list.
